item.title: My First Epic Tech projects
item.description: Welcome to my brand new blog! This content is being parsed dynamically from a raw file using my custom CMS engine Welcome to my official tech blog! Today I am testing out my custom-built Java engine, which dynamically converts these plain text files into clean HTML codes.
item.author: Murungi Isaac

item.title: Building Offline tech projects
item.description: This is my second post! I am currently running this entire generator completely offline. No server, no internet, just pure Java code compiling raw text files into HTML.
item.author: Murungi Isaac

item.title: Expanding My Headless CMS
item.description:
Today I successfully integrated a new 'Online Projects' layout section and configured local Git version control for my CMS engine.
The Java parser seamlessly compiles my plain text files into clean HTML. Next, I plan to explore building interactive web elements and diving deeper into system administration workflows.
item.author: Murungi Isaac
